name: Secret Cinema
description: Secret Cinema is a Private ratioless site for rare MOVIES.

levelRequirements.name: Actor
levelRequirements.privilege: The default class for all members.

levelRequirements.name: Cinematographer
levelRequirements.privilege: Can access the Secret Pharmacy forum and create 1 personal collage. Can also invite new members upon having enough Seeding Points.

levelRequirements.name: Director
levelRequirements.privilege: Can access the Secret Pharmacy forum, create 3 personal collages and is awarded an invite occasionally

levelRequirements.name: Cinephile
levelRequirements.privilege: Can access the Secret Pharmacy and Ilium Cinephilium forums, create 10 personal collages and is awarded an invite occasionally.

levelRequirements.name: Legend
levelRequirements.privilege: Past staff member. Same perks as Cinephiles, plus a few more.
